user.title: Connect to AstrBot
user.description: Enter the AstrBot server address and the dedicated OpenAPI key details. The API key is stored as a secret. No chat request is sent during setup.

data_description.base_url: Enter the server address, including port 6185 when using the default port. Do not append /api/v1/chat.
data_description.api_key: The dedicated OpenAPI key with the chat scope.
data_description.api_key_id: The non-secret key_id returned when the OpenAPI key was created or listed.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters, or the /api/v1/chat endpoint.
